outDir variant, reasoned not measured: an exact-string match makes a variant (`trailing slash`, `..`, another folder) a non-card spec, so the call takes the restart path. The restart cap of 1.00, the earlier RESTART_START and the report point 0.5 are all stricter than the card values, and the restart scan still includes cards/muse, so the variant cannot permit overspend. An exact card spec mixed with a variant is refused as mixed. The adversarial round tests this edge; Review A did not run an empirical variant script.
